title: BNCI 2015-006 Music BCI dataset
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 11 healthy participants performing a multi-streamed musical oddball task designed to investigate auditory selective attention in a brain-computer interface context. Participants attended to one of three concurrent instruments in polyphonic music clips while counting deviants, with offline classification achieving 91% accuracy. The dataset includes preprocessed EEG data (64 channels, 250 Hz sampling rate) with P300 and early auditory components, providing a novel resource for auditory BCI research and music perception studies.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz using 64 active electrodes (Brain Products actiCAP, 10-10 montage) referenced to left mastoid. Data were downsampled to 250 Hz and lowpass filtered using a Chebyshev filter (42 Hz passband, 49 Hz stopband). Epochs were extracted from -200 to 1200 ms relative to stimulus onset, baseline corrected, and artifact rejected using a min-max criterion (100 μV threshold on Fp1/Fp2). Classification employed Linear Discriminant Analysis with shrinkage covariance on spatio-temporal features (3 time intervals × 63 electrodes). Leave-one-clip-out cross-validation was used for evaluation.
